in_sanskrit.name: भूमिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who gets a role or a part or a position in any activity or play. One who appears in a scene or an event.

in_hindi.name: भूमिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: Role, part, position, appearance. In Hindu mythology, Bhoomika refers to the Earth Goddess, who is the consort of Lord Vishnu and is the mother of all beings.

in_tamil.name: பூமிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is related to the Earth (Pūmi).

in_telugu.name: భూమిక
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is related to the Earth (Bhūmi).

in_marathi.name: Bhoomika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhoomika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhoomika refers to a woman whose roots are deeply grounded in her culture, traditions, and values. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhoomi', meaning 'earth', Bhoomika signifies a connection to the earth, symbolizing stability, nurturing, and growth. This name is often given to a baby girl to bless her with a strong foundation and a deep sense of belonging.
